claude-code-sendmessage.md.summary: Verbatim documentation and GitHub issue analysis of the Claude Code SendMessage tool as of v2.1.211 (July 15, 2026), centered on the addressing split between the newly-documented "main" sibling-roster literal for background Agent-tool subagents (v2.1.206+) and the still-undocumented "team-lead" fallback for agent-teams teammates; corrects prior passes' framing that SendMessage requires the Agent Teams flag (it doesn't, only structured team-protocol messages do) and their conflicting version attributions for the stale-name-reuse fix (now confirmed v2.1.199); documents the v2.1.198 background-by-default subagent spawn flip, 5-level subagent nesting, and confirms #43706 (background teammate to lead) and #577 (SDK-mode teammate to lead) remain unresolved.
